title: "Blue Tarp Detection — Complete Pipeline"
output:
  html_document: default
  word_document: default

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# load everything
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(discrim)
library(ranger)
library(vip)
set.seed(42)

# file inputs
train_csv   <- "HaitiPixels.csv"
holdout_dir <- "ROI_files"    # your folder of ROI_*.txt files

# load & label
df <- read_csv(train_csv, show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    target = if_else(
      str_detect(tolower(Class),"blue") & str_detect(tolower(Class),"tarp"),
      "tarp","other"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(target, Red, Green, Blue) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(target=factor(target, levels=c("tarp","other")))

# class counts
count(df, target, name="n") %>% write_csv("class_counts.csv")

# per-band summary
df %>%
  group_by(target) %>%
  summarise(
    Red_mean   = mean(Red),   Red_sd   = sd(Red),
    Green_mean = mean(Green), Green_sd = sd(Green),
    Blue_mean  = mean(Blue),  Blue_sd  = sd(Blue),
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>%
  write_csv("band_summary.csv")

# histograms
p1 <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Red,Green,Blue), names_to="band", values_to="value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(value, fill=target)) +
    geom_histogram(alpha=0.5, position="identity", bins=30) +
    facet_wrap(~band, scales="free_x") +
    labs(title="RGB Distributions by Class", x="DN", y="Count") +
    theme_minimal()
ggsave("band_histograms.png", p1, width=8, height=5)

# recipe + folds
rec   <- recipe(target~Red+Green+Blue, data=df) %>% step_normalize(all_predictors())
folds <- vfold_cv(df, v=5, strata=target)

# model specs
specs <- list(
  log  = logistic_reg() %>% set_engine("glm")    %>% set_mode("classification"),
  lda  = discrim_linear() %>% set_engine("MASS") %>% set_mode("classification"),
  qda  = discrim_quad()   %>% set_engine("MASS") %>% set_mode("classification"),
  knn  = nearest_neighbor(neighbors=tune()) %>% set_engine("kknn") %>% set_mode("classification"),
  enet = logistic_reg(penalty=tune(), mixture=tune()) %>% set_engine("glmnet") %>% set_mode("classification"),
  rf   = rand_forest(trees=500) %>% set_engine("ranger") %>% set_mode("classification")
)

# workflows
wfs <- map(specs, ~ workflow() %>% add_recipe(rec) %>% add_model(.x))

# resample / tune
res <- list(
  log  = fit_resamples(wfs$log,  folds, metrics=metric_set(roc_auc,pr_auc), control=control_resamples(save_pred=TRUE)),
  lda  = fit_resamples(wfs$lda,  folds, metrics=metric_set(roc_auc,pr_auc), control=control_resamples(save_pred=TRUE)),
  qda  = fit_resamples(wfs$qda,  folds, metrics=metric_set(roc_auc,pr_auc), control=control_resamples(save_pred=TRUE)),
  knn  = tune_grid   (wfs$knn, folds, grid=grid_regular(neighbors(range=c(5,15)),levels=3), metrics=metric_set(roc_auc,pr_auc), control=control_grid(save_pred=TRUE)),
  enet = tune_grid   (wfs$enet,folds, grid=grid_regular(penalty(),mixture(),levels=3),      metrics=metric_set(roc_auc,pr_auc), control=control_grid(save_pred=TRUE)),
  rf   = fit_resamples(wfs$rf,   folds, metrics=metric_set(roc_auc,pr_auc), control=control_resamples(save_pred=TRUE))
)

# collect & save
map2_dfr(res, names(res), ~collect_metrics(.x) %>% mutate(model=.y)) %>%
  filter(.metric %in% c("roc_auc","pr_auc")) %>%
  select(model,.metric,mean,std_err) %>%
  write_csv("cv_metrics.csv")

# pick best by ROC AUC
cv_sum <- read_csv("cv_metrics.csv")
best_model <- cv_sum %>%
  filter(.metric=="roc_auc") %>%
  slice_max(mean) %>%
  pull(model)

# finalize workflow
wf_best <- wfs[[best_model]]
if(best_model %in% c("knn","enet")) {
  best_par <- select_best(res[[best_model]], "roc_auc")
  wf_best <- finalize_workflow(wf_best, best_par)
}

# splits
split1   <- initial_split(df, prop=0.8, strata=target)
train    <- training(split1); test <- testing(split1)
split2   <- initial_split(train, prop=0.75, strata=target)
subtrain <- training(split2); valid <- testing(split2)

# fit & get validation probs
fit_best <- fit(wf_best, subtrain)
val_pred <- predict(fit_best, valid, type="prob") %>% bind_cols(valid)

# scan F1
ths <- seq(0,1,by=0.01)
f1s <- sapply(ths, function(t)
  yardstick::f_meas_vec(
    truth=factor(val_pred$target,levels=c("tarp","other")),
    estimate=factor(ifelse(val_pred$.pred_tarp>=t,"tarp","other"),levels=c("tarp","other")),
    event_level="first"
  )
)
validation_f1 <- tibble(threshold=ths, f1=f1s)
write_csv(validation_f1, "validation_f1_by_threshold.csv")

p_f1 <- ggplot(validation_f1, aes(threshold,f1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth=1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=ths[which.max(f1s)], linetype="dashed", color="red") +
  labs(title="F₁ vs Threshold", x="Threshold", y="F₁") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("f1_threshold.png", p_f1, width=6, height=4)

best_th <- ths[which.max(f1s)]
cat("Chosen threshold:", best_th, "\n")

test_pred <- predict(fit_best, test, type="prob") %>% bind_cols(test) %>%
  mutate(.pred_class=factor(if_else(.pred_tarp>=best_th,"tarp","other"),levels=c("tarp","other")))

# metrics table
metric_set(roc_auc,pr_auc,accuracy,precision,recall,f_meas)(
  test_pred, truth=target, estimate=.pred_class, .pred_tarp, event_level="first"
) %>% write_csv("test_metrics.csv")

# curves + CM
rc  <- roc_curve(test_pred, truth=target, .pred_tarp, event_level="first")
pr  <- pr_curve (test_pred, truth=target, .pred_tarp, event_level="first")
cm  <- conf_mat(test_pred, truth=target, estimate=.pred_class)

ggsave("roc.png",  autoplot(rc) + theme_minimal(), width=6, height=4)
ggsave("pr.png",   autoplot(pr) + theme_minimal(), width=6, height=4)
ggsave("confusion_matrix.png",
       autoplot(cm, type="heatmap") + theme_minimal(),
       width=4, height=4)

# reader fn
read_roi <- function(path, lab){
  hdr <- readLines(path, n=200)
  idx <- which(grepl("^;\\s*ID\\s+X", hdr))[1]
  x <- read_table(path,
           skip = ifelse(is.na(idx),0,idx),
           comment="", col_names=c("ID","X","Y","MapX","MapY","Lat","Lon","B1","B2","B3"),
           col_types=cols(.default="d"))
  transmute(x, Red=B1,Green=B2,Blue=B3,target=lab,file=basename(path))
}

# load & bind
pos <- list.files(holdout_dir,"ROI_Blue_Tarps\\.txt$",full.names=TRUE,ignore.case=TRUE)
neg <- list.files(holdout_dir,"ROI_(NOT|NON)_Blue_Tarps\\.txt$",full.names=TRUE,ignore.case=TRUE)
hold <- bind_rows(
  if(length(pos)) map_dfr(pos, ~read_roi(.x,"tarp")) else tibble(),
  if(length(neg)) map_dfr(neg, ~read_roi(.x,"other")) else tibble()
) %>% drop_na()

# predict & metrics
pred_hold <- predict(fit_best, hold, type="prob") %>%
  bind_cols(hold) %>%
  mutate(target=factor(target,levels=c("tarp","other")),
         .pred_class=factor(if_else(.pred_tarp>=best_th,"tarp","other"),levels=c("tarp","other")))

metric_set(roc_auc,pr_auc,accuracy,precision,recall,f_meas)(
  pred_hold, truth=target, estimate=.pred_class, .pred_tarp, event_level="first"
) %>% write_csv("holdout_metrics.csv")

# per-image rates
pred_hold %>%
  group_by(file) %>%
  summarise(pixels=n(), tarp=sum(.pred_class=="tarp"), tarp_rate=tarp/pixels, .groups="drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(tarp_rate)) %>%
  write_csv("holdout_per_image.csv")

# re-fit RF on subtrain with importance
rf_obj <- ranger(target~Red+Green+Blue,
                 data=training(split2),
                 num.trees=500,
                 importance="impurity",
                 probability=TRUE)
p_vip <- vip(rf_obj) +
  labs(title="RF Variable Importance") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("vip.png", p_vip, width=6, height=4)
